results.text: The Neuroepithelial Landscape of Enterochromaffin Cells Varies Across Gastrointestinal Location. Enteroendocrine cells (EECs) lining the gastrointestinal (GI) wall sense chemical and mechanical changes in the gut, secreting an array of hormones and neurotransmitters in response. Enterochromaffin (EC) cells synthesize and secrete serotonin and represent approximately half of all EECs.
